title: Comptime Intro
concept: Comptime executes code at compile time instead of runtime — generating types, validating structures, and computing constants before the binary is built.
why: Why compute at runtime what you can compute at compile time? Comptime moves work earlier in the pipeline, catching errors sooner and generating zero-runtime-overhead code.
tips: Use comptime for initialization that's expensive at runtime but cheap at compile time
Comptime validation catches configuration errors before deployment — fail at build, not at 3 AM
Comptime functions can't do I/O (except reading embeddable files) — they're pure computation
The comptime subset of XIOM is identical to runtime XIOM — no special syntax to learn
common_mistakes: Trying to use runtime values in comptime — comptime runs before main(), no runtime data available
Making comptime too complex — if it significantly increases compile time, consider caching or pre-building
Assuming comptime has access to network/filesystem by default — it's sandboxed for reproducible builds
